notes: Verified: official Nintendo microcode and libultra are proprietary. libdragon (Unlicense) supplies a complete open replacement path: own RSP ucodes on an rspq command queue, open-source IPL3, GCC-based toolchain, OpenGL 1.1 port. Clean-room revival of the microcode family's capabilities is demonstrated in practice.
title: N64 GBI / Fast3D microcode lineage record
